content.title: 50 Best April Fools' Day Jokes That'll Guarantee Laughs
content.text: Yes, April Fools' Day is famous for hilarious pranks, practical jokes, media hoaxes, and general tomfoolery. But for those of you who don't have time to plan elaborate pranks, have run out of big ideas, or simply forgot about the holiday until this very moment, we've got just the thing for you. We've gathered the best April Fools' Day jokes that are packed with enough hilarious puns, clever wordplay, and knock-knock joke openings to share with your friends, family, coworkers, and anyone else you're spending April 1 with: 1. Which day is the worst to propose on? April Fools’ Day. 2. Why are babies born on March 31 the easiest to prank on April Fools’ Day? They were literally born yesterday. 3. It's April Fools' Day. Trust no one and nothing. Just like any other day. 4. What is the luckiest card in a deck for April Fools' Day? The Joker. 5. Why was everyone so tired on April 1? Because they just finished a long 31-day March. 6. What’s the biggest difference between Thanksgiving and April Fools’ Day? On one you’re thankful, and on the other you’re prankful. 7. I played an April Fools' Day joke on my parkour team this morning. They all fell for it. 8. A and C were going to prank their friend…but they just letter B. 9. My local library put out an "invisible books" display for April Fools' Day, but I saw right through it. 10. What do you call a realistic prankster? A practical joker. 11. I don’t always joke on April Fools’ Day. Just kidding, I do. 12. What is a gas pump’s favorite holiday? April Fuel’s Day. 13. Why was the donkey annoying his friend? It was April Mules’ Day! 14. Who needs a day for the fools? I’m surrounded by them all year. 15. Why do eggs like April Fools’ Day? They love practical yolks. 16. What is a prankster’s favorite toy? Silly String. 17. Excuse me, sir. Do you think they named April Fools’ Day in your honor? 18. What do you write in a birthday card on April Fools' Day? You can prank me later. 19. Knock, knock! Who’s there? Noah. Noah who? Noah good April Fools’ joke? 20. A couple of pranksters broke into the local police station and stole all the lavatory equipment. A spokesperson was quoted as saying, “We have absolutely nothing to go on.” 21. What’s one bone a prankster doesn’t want to break on April Fools’ Day? The humerus. 22. Why were the monkeys pranking each other? It was the first of Ape-ril! 23. What is a stepladder's favorite day? April Stools' Day! 24. How would a husband scare his wife on April 1st? By opening a new prank account. 25. What did the calendar say after April Fools' was declared a holiday? Prank you, prank you very much. 26. Why do bees become so indecisive after April? They become may-bees. 27. What did the tree say after it got through April 1st prank-free? That was a re-leaf! 28. If April showers bring May flowers, what do May flowers bring? Pilgrims. 29. What do you call a hammer bought on April 1? An April tool. 30. Keanu Reeves lost all the April Fools' jokes! Luckily he found the May tricks. 31. What did the villain say to the superheroes who thought it was still March? It’s April, Fools! 32. How is the letter “A” like a flower? A bee comes after it. 33. Did you hear about the guy who drank invisible ink as an April Fools' prank? He's at the doctor waiting to be seen. 34. How do you keep a fool in suspense? I’ll tell you the answer tomorrow. 35. Why shouldn't you tell ducks jokes on April Fools' Day? They'll quack up. 36. Can February march? No, but April May. 37. Did you hear about the goats that got in trouble for playing pranks on April Fools'? It turned out to be a couple of kids. 38. What do April Fools' Day and open mic nights have in common? People go out of their way to demonstrate how unfunny they are. 39. Knock, knock! Who's there? Gwen. Gwen who? Gwen do you think you're gonna prank me, let's get it over with. 40. What monster plays the most April Fools’ jokes? Prankenstein. 41. Joke’s on you, April Fools’ Day. I can be fooled any day of the year. 42. What did April Fools' say when it received a gift? Well, prank you! 43. How can you tell when April is happy? It has a spring in its step. 44. What goes up when April showers come down? An umbrella. 45. How do April flowers kiss? With their tu-lips. 46. What do you call an Easter bunny with fleas? Bugs Bunny. 47. What did one spring chicken say to the other? You're looking egg-cellent. 48. What did summer say to spring? I’m going to fall! 49. What do you call a bear caught in April showers? A drizzly bear. 50. Which superhero likes April the most? Robin. Do you have a favorite April Fools' Day joke? Drop it in the comments below!
